arxiv-2107-05223.creator: Yi-Hui ChouCarnegie Mellon University, United States yihuic@andrew.cmu.edu, I-Chun ChenNational Tsing Hua University, Taiwan icchen0101@elsa.cs.nthu.edu.tw Chin-Jui ChangResearch Center for IT Innovation, Academia Sinica, Taiwan csc63182@citi.sinica.edu.tw Joann ChingResearch Center for IT Innovatio
arxiv-2107-05223.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Yi-Hui ChouCarnegie Mellon University, United States yihuic@andrew.cmu.edu, I-Chun ChenNational Tsing Hua University, Taiwan icchen0101@elsa.cs.nthu.edu.tw Chin-Jui ChangResearch Center for IT Innovation, Academia Sinica, Taiwan csc63182@citi.sinica.edu.tw Joann ChingResearch Center for IT Innovatio. This article presents a benchmark study of symbolic piano music classification using the masked language modelling approach of the Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers (BERT).

arxiv-2210-06104.title: EduQG: A Multi-format Multiple Choice Dataset for the Educational Domain Thanks: The authors are with the Text-to-Knowledge (T2K) team at IDLab, Ghent University-imec, Belgium. (e-mail: amir.hadifar, firstname.lastname@ugent.be)
arxiv-2210-06104.creator: Amir Hadifar, Semere Kiros Bitew, Johannes Deleu
arxiv-2210-06104.description: Abstract We introduce a high-quality dataset that contains 3,397 samples comprising 1. multiple choice questions, 2. answers (including distractors), and 3. their source documents, from the educational domain. Each question is phrased in two forms, normal and cloze. Correct answers are linked to source documents with sentence-level annotations.

arxiv-2302-13111.title: Heat-type Equations on manifolds with fibered boundaries II: Parametrix construction
arxiv-2302-13111.creator: Bruno Caldeira, Giuseppe Gentile
arxiv-2302-13111.description: Abstract . This is the second part of a two parts work on the analysis of heat-type equations on manifolds with fibered boundary equipped with a Φ \Phi -metric. This setting generalizes the asymptotically conical (scattering) spaces and includes special cases of magnetic and gravitational monopoles.

arxiv-2310-04468.title: Validating transformers for redaction of text from electronic health records in real-world healthcare
arxiv-2310-04468.creator: 1 st Zeljko Kraljevic, 2 nd Anthony Shek, 3 rd Joshua Au Yeung, 4 th Ewart Jonathan Sheldon, 5 th Haris Shuaib, 6 th Mohammad Al-Agil, 7 th Xi Bai, 8 th Kawsar Noor, 9 th Anoop D. Shah, 10 th Richard Dobson, 11 th James Teo
arxiv-2310-04468.description: Abstract Protecting patient privacy in healthcare records is a top priority, and redaction is a commonly used method for obscuring directly identifiable information in text. Rule-based methods have been widely used, but their precision is often low causing over-redaction of text and frequently not being adaptable enough for non-standardised or unconventional structures of personal health information.

arxiv-2501-03634.title: Anisotropic magnetism and spin fluctuations in the triangular-lattice spin-liquid candidate NaYbSe 2 : a single-crystal 23 Na and 77 Se NMR study
arxiv-2501-03634.creator: S. Luther, K. M. Ranjith, Th. Doert, J. Wosnitza, H. Kühne, M. Baenitz
arxiv-2501-03634.description: Abstract The ytterbium-based delafossite NaYbSe 2 is discussed as a prototype for a spin-orbit entangled, effective spin-1/2 triangular spin lattice with emerging antiferromagnetic correlations and a quantum-spin-liquid (QSL) ground state. We report on a comprehensive study of the static and dynamic anisotropic magnetism in single-crystalline samples of NaYbSe 2 , using NMR spectroscopy as a local-probe technique.

arxiv-2508-00605.title: GHTM: A Graph based Hybrid Topic Modeling Approach in Low-Resource Bengali Language
arxiv-2508-00605.creator: Farhana Haque, Md. Abdur Rahman, Dr. Sumon Ahmed
arxiv-2508-00605.description: Abstract Topic modeling is a Natural Language Processing (NLP) technique that is used to identify latent themes and extract topics from text corpora by grouping similar documents based on their most significant keywords. Although widely researched in English, topic modeling remains understudied in Bengali due to its morphological complexity, lack of adequate resources and initiatives.

arxiv-2511-00030.title: Probing Knowledge Holes in Unlearned LLMs This paper contains model outputs that can be harmful in nature.
arxiv-2511-00030.creator: Myeongseob KoVirginia Tech myeongseob@vt.edu, Hoang Anh JustVirginia Tech just@vt.edu Charles FlemingCisco Research chflemin@cisco.com Ming JinVirginia Tech jinming@vt.edu Ruoxi JiaVirginia Tech ruoxijia@vt.edu
arxiv-2511-00030.description: Abstract Machine unlearning has emerged as a prevalent technical solution for selectively removing unwanted knowledge absorbed during pre-training, without requiring full retraining. While recent unlearning techniques can effectively remove undesirable content without severely compromising performance on standard benchmarks, we find that they may inadvertently create “knowledge holes”—unintended losses of benign knowledge that standard benchmarks fail to capture.

pmc-11286069.title: ST913-IVa-t991 Methicillin-Resistant Staphylococcus aureus among Pediatric Patients, Israel
pmc-11286069.creator: Moti Baum, Einav Anuka, Maya Davidovich-Cohen, Assaf Rokney
pmc-11286069.description: In Israel, prevalence of sequence type 913, staphylococcal cassette chromosome mecIVa, spa type t991 methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus lineage has surged among pediatric populations, predominantly in Arab and Orthodox Jewish communities. Antimicrobial resistance patterns vary by demographics. This lineage's spread and microevolution in the Middle East underscore the need for ongoing surveillance.

pmc-11484955.title: A multiantigenic Orf virus-based vaccine efficiently protects hamsters and nonhuman primates against SARS-CoV-2
pmc-11484955.creator: Alena Reguzova, Melanie Müller, Felix Pagallies, Dominique Burri, Ferdinand Salomon, Hanns-Joachim Rziha, Zsofia Bittner-Schrader, Babs E. Verstrepen, Kinga P. pmc-11484955.description: Among the common strategies to design next-generation COVID-19 vaccines is broadening the antigenic repertoire thereby aiming to increase efficacy against emerging variants of concern (VoC). This study describes a new Orf virus-based vector (ORFV) platform to design a multiantigenic vaccine targeting SARS-CoV-2 spike and nucleocapsid antigens.

uslaw-usc-t15-s80b9.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t15-s80b9.description: United States Code, Title 15 (Commerce And Trade); Chapter 2D (Investment Companies And Advisers); Subchapter II (Investment Advisers). (a) Investigation Whenever it shall appear to the Commission, either upon complaint or otherwise, that the provisions of this subchapter or of any rule or regulation prescribed under the authority thereof, have been or are about to be violated.

uslaw-usc-t20-s9901.title: 20 U.S.C. § 9901 — Purpose
uslaw-usc-t20-s9901.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t20-s9901.description: United States Code, Title 20 (Education); Chapter 79 (Stem-Training Grant Program). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The purpose of this chapter is to replicate and implement programs at institutions of higher education that provide integrated courses of study in science, technology, engineering, or mathematics, and teacher education, that lead to a baccalaureate degree in science, technology, engineering, or mathematics with concurrent teacher.
